claim: The download page selects a published installer for the visitor's platform from GitHub API metadata.
sandbox: fresh browser context; mocked deterministic api.github.com release fixture; assert the selected asset URL and absence of release-download metadata fetches

claim: Only the first invoice PDF in a reminder thread is archived, even when a later reminder has a changed PDF.
where: landing page, demo, desktop activity, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/; bundled three-message thread; assert one archive, two skips, and changed-PDF thread reason

claim: The sample demo is isolated from real data and makes no external requests.
where: landing action, demo banner, privacy page
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/; run sample; record all requests and localStorage keys

claim: The audit can be exported as CSV.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/; run bundled thread; inspect downloaded CSV header and three decision rows

claim: The desktop interface does not send rules or activity to a product server.
where: landing privacy facts, desktop navigation, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context against desktop UI; record all requests while opening rules and activity; assert same-origin only

claim: The product demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; install service worker online; set context offline; reload /demo/

claim: The desktop app supports OAuth setup for Google and Microsoft mailboxes.
sandbox: fresh browser context against desktop UI; select OAuth and assert both providers, client ID, and connect action

claim: Mailroom Plus is listed at $29 once, and the unavailable checkout is shown honestly without a dead purchase link.
where: landing pricing, desktop Plus view, terms, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert exact price, included feature, operator-gated checkout state, and absence of a checkout href

claim: A valid license enables extra rules and timed checks; a revoked license turns paid features off.
sandbox: fresh desktop webview fixture; recorded valid and revoked verification responses; assert paid controls, 15-minute timer, request URLs, and relock

claim: A returned license token is stored locally and removed from the visible URL.
where: desktop Plus view and privacy page
sandbox: isolated URL and recording browser-storage fixture; assert token storage and removal of the license query parameter

claim: A valid license verdict is reused for no more than one day.
sandbox: deterministic browser-storage fixture and clock; assert valid verdict before expiry and cache miss after one day

claim: Separate invoices with the same subject stay separate, while RFC-linked replies share one invoice thread.
sandbox: deterministic MIME fixtures for two senders and a recurring invoice with the same subject

claim: Only one scan can deliver a canonical invoice at a time.
sandbox: two deterministic concurrent delivery paths share the native scan gate

claim: The installed app can load an in-memory sample project without contacting a mailbox.
where: desktop first-run screen and landing walkthrough
sandbox: fresh desktop webview fixture; invoke bundled sample action and assert one archive, two skips, and no mailbox action

claim: The macOS and Linux install script checks SHA-256 before installing a release asset.
sandbox: isolated local curl fixture; execute the published POSIX script and assert only the checksum-matched asset is installed

claim: The Windows install script checks SHA-256 before starting a release installer.
sandbox: isolated PowerShell web fixture; execute the published Windows script and assert only the checksum-matched installer is started

claim: Every release publishes SHA256SUMS and source-commit metadata for all six platform packages.
sandbox: temporary six-package release fixture; run the production manifest generator; verify each checksum and exact source commit

claim: The oldest matching PDF wins even when chained reply headers sort differently from mailbox UIDs.
where: desktop sorting rules, landing how-it-works, README
sandbox: three deterministic MIME messages with reversed fetch order and adversarial In-Reply-To plus References values

claim: A preview models earlier decisions in the same scan without writing canonical records.
sandbox: fresh in-memory SQLite database; two linked new messages; assert one preview, one skip, and zero persisted canonicals

claim: Mailroom applies the full subject and sender rule before fetching content and uses read-only IMAP access without marking messages read.
where: desktop rules and activity, privacy page, README
sandbox: deterministic rule and MIME fixtures; assert combined server search, UID BODY.PEEK fetch, and rejection of a wrong sender

claim: Passwords and OAuth tokens are routed to the operating-system credential store and excluded from settings JSON.
where: desktop mailbox setup, privacy page, README
sandbox: recording credential-store boundary with password and OAuth fixtures; serialize settings and assert no secret appears

claim: Sorting rules, PDF hashes, and audit entries are stored in local JSON and SQLite files.
where: landing privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; write and reopen a rule JSON file and SQLite canonical/audit records

claim: The product website sends no tracking or visitor data; its only external page request is public GitHub release metadata.
where: landing privacy section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context with recorded requests and deterministic GitHub response; assert the sole external request and no analytics endpoint
